view_patch.validation_scope_note: City-on interpolation check; not a second direct transfer experiment for city-off.

field.interpolation: view-local positive tensor PCHIP on unit-sphere gnomonic rays; periodic bilinear outside patch

spectral_bridge.city: CIE photopic/scotopic integrals of transported lamp-scenario spectra
spectral_bridge.unresolved: V-to-photopic proxy from Cox/Crumey; S/P is explicit scenario, no full natural/Moon SED

assumptions: completed local adaptation; binocular normal/averted viewing
observer_factor_excludes_atmosphere; stellar transmission applied exactly once
local background approximation, no direct nearby glare or adaptation dynamics
threshold relation does not determine suprathreshold colour or apparent brightness
counts refer to available BSC5P catalogue entries; faint-end completeness and unresolved multiples are not fitted
no individual observer calibration or matched visual field validation

display.encoding: exactly one sRGB transfer; dither only at final 8-bit quantization
display.viewing_assumptions: no direct lamps or Moon; completed local adaptation, binocular/averted viewing
display.appearance_gate: Crumey total at-eye threshold once, before tone; no probability or calibrated suprathreshold response
display.unresolved_starlight: diffuse residual excludes catalogue point sources by convention; source separation not independently measured
